name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Internship
benefit:
**Duration of the Summer/Winter Camp:** 5 days (excluding the days of Journey)
**Nature of the Camp:** Residential except in Metropolitan Cities
<br>

> **For the Interns:**

   1. Each day the schedule of the Program should comprise at least two lectures cum discussion of one and a half hours in the morning hours followed by hands-on experience in the second half (i.e., 1400Hrs to 1730hr
_eligibility_text:
> **For the Interns** 1. The applicant should be a School Student. 1. The applicant should be in the top one percent ranking in their 10th Board Examination. 1. The applicant should be pursuing Science in Class 11th. 1. The applicant should not have attended a similar camp earlier. 1. The applicant should be within the same State or Union Territory.
**Note:** In case the number of top 1% students of a respective examination board is more than the allocated number of INSPIRE interns, for participation in such camps, of the respective state/UT, top rankers will be selected for INSPIRE Internship science camp provided they had applied for the same.
> **For the Science Camp Organizers** 1. University/College or Academic/Research institute should have the required infrastructure of related Science Laboratories for holding INSPIRE InternshipCamps. 1. Availability of auditorium with well-equipped sound system and LCD projectors. 1. Availability of Guest House, Hostel for Girls and Boys, with holding capacities. 1. University, College, or academic/Research institute shall owe the administrative and financial responsibility for the organization of INSPIRE Internship Camp.
**For the Mentors** 1. Mentors for INSPIRE Internship would be various Academy Fellows, Bhatnagar Awardees, Scientists, and academicians of National and International repute.
